import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb

# Load all data
train_data = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_data = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

# Get target and feature columns
target = "Cover_Type"
feature_cols = [col for col in train_data.columns if col not in ["Id", target]]

# Prepare training and test data
X_train = train_data[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_data[target]
X_test = test_data[feature_cols].copy()

# Hold-out validation split (model never sees this during fitting)
X_train_val, X_val, y_train_val, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Create ensemble of 3 LightGBM models with different hyperparameters
models = []
params_list = [
    {
        "n_estimators": 300,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "max_depth": 5,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    },
    {
        "n_estimators": 300,
        "learning_rate": 0.1,
        "max_depth": 7,
        "subsample": 0.7,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.9,
    },
    {
        "n_estimators": 300,
        "learning_rate": 0.15,
        "max_depth": 8,
        "subsample": 0.9,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.7,
    },
]

for i, params in enumerate(params_list):
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params, random_state=42, verbosity=-1)
    model.fit(X_train_val, y_train_val)
    models.append(model)

# Average predictions on validation set
val_predictions = np.zeros(len(y_val), dtype=float)
for model in models:
    val_predictions += model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, -1] / len(models)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(np.argmax(val_predictions, axis=1), y_val)

# Generate predictions on test data by averaging all models' predictions
test_proba_preds = np.zeros((len(X_test), len(np.unique(y_train))))
for model in models:
    test_proba_preds += model.predict_proba(X_test)
test_pred_classes = np.argmax(test_proba_preds, axis=1)
test_predictions = test_pred_classes.astype(int)

# Create submission file with correct format
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["Cover_Type"] = test_predictions
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Print evaluation metric as required
print(val_accuracy)
